title: Asgard Shield: Reloaded Crash Fix
description: Fixes crashes with Asgard Shield's blocking ability.
body: Requires Asgard Shield: Reloaded as a dependency. Patch mod for Asgard Shield: Reloaded to fix a crash, or ticking entity error, caused by Asgard Shield: Reloaded not expecting a non-player hand. This occurs when using the weapons in Create Deployers or other player simulators.
